observational_cohort.label: Observational cohort
observational_cohort.question: Among a defined population, how does exposure relate to a subsequent outcome?
workflow: Set index date and exposure window

case_control.label: Case-control
case_control.question: Are prior exposures associated with case status?

cross_sectional.label: Cross-sectional
cross_sectional.question: What is the prevalence or distribution of a characteristic at a defined time?
workflow: Define target population and sampling frame

randomized_trial.label: Randomized controlled trial
randomized_trial.question: What is the effect of assignment to an intervention versus comparator?
workflow: Define primary endpoint and time point

diagnostic_accuracy.label: Diagnostic accuracy
diagnostic_accuracy.question: How accurately does an index test classify a target condition against a reference standard?

case_series.label: Case series
case_series.question: What characteristics are observed in a defined series?

registry_longitudinal.label: Registry / longitudinal
registry_longitudinal.question: How do characteristics, exposures or outcomes evolve over repeated observations?
workflow: Specify time origin and repeated measures
